title: [dev-g] BG Source gets reset to BYODA when switching to latest build
symptom: Switching to latest dev build (d57ec150a5789a61f15c2781bf20ea5a90ae0644), the BG Source (in my case xDrip+) gets reset to BYODA.
cause: The BG Source reset is due to a commit where XdripPlugin was renamed to XdripSourcePlugin to have original name preserved for xDrip synchronization plugin.
fix: The issue cannot be resolved; it must be mentioned in release notes.
evidence_quote: right. it's due to https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/c71fc275a544bd3ae477549e8786e4188a69fe70 where XdripPlugin was renamed to XdripSourcePlugin to have original name preserved for xDrip synchronization plugin. I believe new naming convention is more logical but it means we cannot resolve this issue.
